title: Exodus Chapter 31 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Exodus chapter 31 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Exodus Chapter 31 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Exodus Chapter 31.

questions.question: Who did the LORD call by name to work on the tabernacle?
questions.correctAnswer: Bezaleel
questions.explanation: Exodus 31:2 states that the LORD called Bezaleel by name to work on the tabernacle.

questions.question: From which tribe was Bezaleel, the son of Uri?
questions.correctAnswer: Judah
questions.explanation: Exodus 31:2 identifies Bezaleel as being from the tribe of Judah.

questions.question: What did God fill Bezaleel with to enable him to do his work?
options: Spirit of God, wisdom, understanding, knowledge
questions.correctAnswer: Spirit of God, wisdom, understanding, knowledge
questions.explanation: Exodus 31:3 explains that God filled Bezaleel with the spirit of God, wisdom, understanding, and knowledge.

questions.question: True or False: Bezaleel was skilled to work only in gold and silver.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Exodus 31:4-5 shows Bezaleel was skilled in gold, silver, brass, cutting stones, and carving timber.

questions.question: What kinds of materials was Bezaleel skilled to work with?
questions.correctAnswer: Gold, silver, brass, stones, timber
questions.explanation: Exodus 31:4-5 describes Bezaleel's skills in working gold, silver, brass, stones, and timber.

questions.question: Who was given along with Bezaleel to assist in the work?
questions.correctAnswer: Aholiab
questions.explanation: Exodus 31:6 states that God gave Aholiab, son of Ahisamach, to assist Bezaleel.

questions.question: To which tribe did Aholiab belong?
questions.correctAnswer: Dan
questions.explanation: Exodus 31:6 identifies Aholiab as from the tribe of Dan.

questions.question: True or False: Wisdom was put in the hearts of all who were wise-hearted to make all that God commanded.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Exodus 31:6 explains that God put wisdom in the hearts of all who were wise-hearted to do His commands.

questions.question: What is the first thing the LORD instructed Moses regarding the work to be done?
questions.correctAnswer: To call Bezaleel and Aholiab
questions.explanation: Exodus 31:1-6 shows the LORD first instructing Moses to call Bezaleel and Aholiab for the work.

questions.question: Which of the following was NOT mentioned as part of the workmanship Bezaleel was skilled in?
questions.correctAnswer: Weaving cloth
questions.explanation: Exodus 31:4-5 mentions gold, silver, brass, stones, and timber but does not mention weaving cloth as Bezaleel’s skill.

questions.question: True or False: The LORD personally spoke to Moses in this chapter.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Exodus 31:1 and 31:12 show the LORD speaking directly to Moses.

questions.question: What is the relationship between Uri and Bezaleel?
questions.correctAnswer: Uri is Bezaleel’s father
questions.explanation: Exodus 31:2 says Bezaleel is the son of Uri.

questions.question: In Exodus 31, which instruction comes before all the others listed here?
options: Giving Moses the two tables of testimony
questions.correctAnswer: Calling Bezaleel by name
questions.explanation: The LORD first instructs Moses to call Bezaleel by name in Exodus 31:2, before other instructions later in the chapter.

questions.question: Who is described as the son of Ahisamach?
questions.correctAnswer: Aholiab
questions.explanation: Exodus 31:6 identifies Aholiab as the son of Ahisamach.

questions.question: True or False: Bezaleel was filled with the spirit of God in all manner of workmanship.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Exodus 31:3 states Bezaleel was filled with the spirit of God and skill in all manner of workmanship.

medium.title: Exodus Chapter 31 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Exodus Chapter 31 to real-life situations.

questions.question: Who was given wisdom by God to make all that He commanded Moses in Exodus 31?
questions.correctAnswer: Bezaleel and Aholiab
questions.explanation: Exodus 31:6 states that God gave wisdom to Bezaleel and Aholiab, and also to all who are wise-hearted, to make all that He commanded Moses. This is supported by verses 2 and 3 where Bezaleel is filled with the spirit of God, wisdom, understanding, and knowledge.

questions.question: What specific items were the craftsmen commanded to make according to Exodus 31:7-10?
options: The tabernacle, ark of testimony, mercy seat, table and candlestick, altars, laver, priestly garments, anointing oil, and incense
The city gates, walls, and towers
questions.correctAnswer: The tabernacle, ark of testimony, mercy seat, table and candlestick, altars, laver, priestly garments, anointing oil, and incense
questions.explanation: Verses 7 through 10 list the tabernacle, ark of testimony, mercy seat, tables, candlesticks, altars, laver, priestly garments, and more as items to be made according to God's command.

questions.question: According to Exodus 31:11, how were the people instructed to carry out the making of the holy items?
options: According to all that God commanded Moses
Using their own ideas and creativity
questions.correctAnswer: According to all that God commanded Moses
questions.explanation: Verse 11 emphasizes obedience to God's commands about making the holy items just as He instructed Moses, demonstrating faith and trust in God's detailed guidance.

questions.question: What does the keeping of the Sabbath represent according to Exodus 31:13?
options: A sign between God and Israel that He sanctifies them
A day to prepare food for the week
A day to gather more gold and silver
questions.correctAnswer: A sign between God and Israel that He sanctifies them
questions.explanation: Verse 13 explains the Sabbath is a sign between God and the children of Israel throughout their generations to know that God sanctifies them, highlighting holiness and obedience.

questions.question: What consequence is stated in Exodus 31:14 for anyone who defiles the Sabbath by doing work?
options: That person shall surely be put to death
They shall be forgiven after prayer
They will be sent to a different tribe
questions.correctAnswer: That person shall surely be put to death
questions.explanation: Verse 14 clearly states that anyone who defiles the Sabbath by working shall be put to death, underlining the seriousness of honoring God's holy day.

questions.question: How does Exodus 31:15 describe the work schedule in relation to the Sabbath?
options: Six days work may be done, but the seventh is a holy rest day
Work is allowed every day except the first day
Only four days of work are allowed each week
Work should be done continuously without rest
questions.correctAnswer: Six days work may be done, but the seventh is a holy rest day
questions.explanation: Verse 15 instructs that work is permitted for six days, but the seventh day is a Sabbath of rest holy unto the LORD, reinforcing the need for rest and worship.

questions.question: What is the nature of the covenant regarding the Sabbath as described in Exodus 31:16?
options: A perpetual covenant to be observed throughout generations
A temporary command for Moses’ lifetime
A suggestion for special occasions only
A private agreement with the priests
questions.correctAnswer: A perpetual covenant to be observed throughout generations
questions.explanation: Verse 16 explains the Sabbath is a perpetual covenant for the children of Israel to observe throughout their generations, highlighting long-term faithfulness and obedience.

questions.question: What reason does Exodus 31:17 give for the Sabbath being a sign forever between God and Israel?
options: Because God made heaven and earth in six days and rested on the seventh
Because Israel fought their enemies on the seventh day
Because the priests anointed the tabernacle
Because the people gathered manna for six days
questions.correctAnswer: Because God made heaven and earth in six days and rested on the seventh
questions.explanation: Verse 17 states the Sabbath is a sign forever because God created the world in six days and rested on the seventh, then was refreshed, reflecting God's pattern for rest.

questions.question: What did God give Moses at the end of his communication on Mount Sinai as recorded in Exodus 31:18?
options: Two tables of testimony, tables of stone, written with the finger of God
questions.correctAnswer: Two tables of testimony, tables of stone, written with the finger of God
questions.explanation: Verse 18 describes that God gave Moses two stone tables written by God's finger, symbolizing divine authority and covenant.

questions.question: How does the instruction to make the holy garments in Exodus 31:10 emphasize the importance of priestly service?
options: The garments were made for Aaron and his sons to minister in the priest's office
The garments were made for all Israelites to wear daily
The garments were optional for priests to wear
The garments were only for decorative purposes
questions.correctAnswer: The garments were made for Aaron and his sons to minister in the priest's office
questions.explanation: Verse 10 shows the garments were specifically made for Aaron and his sons to minister, highlighting the sacred role and responsibility of priests in worship.

questions.question: True or False: According to Exodus 31:9, the laver and its foot were part of the sanctuary furniture God commanded be made.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Verse 9 explicitly includes the laver and its foot among the sanctuary furnishings to be constructed as commanded by God, underscoring the importance of ritual cleansing.

questions.question: True or False: Exodus 31 teaches that only Moses and Aaron were given wisdom to build the tabernacle and its furnishings.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Verse 6 clarifies that wisdom was given to Bezaleel, Aholiab, and all wise-hearted people, not only Moses and Aaron, to build the tabernacle and its furnishings.

questions.question: True or False: Exodus 31:12 shows that God spoke to Moses again to command the observance of the Sabbath after instructing about the tabernacle furnishings.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Verse 12 indicates God spoke again to Moses to give the important command to keep the Sabbath, linking worship and obedience to both the sanctuary and the Sabbath.

questions.question: What biblical virtue is emphasized by the detailed instructions for making the tabernacle and its furnishings in Exodus 31:7-11?
options: Obedience and faithfulness to God's commands
questions.correctAnswer: Obedience and faithfulness to God's commands
questions.explanation: The detailed instructions in verses 7-11 emphasize the need for obedience and faithfulness to God's exact commands in worship, teaching humility and reverence.

questions.question: How does Exodus 31:14-15 warn the community about the seriousness of desecrating the Sabbath in relation to community purity?
options: The soul that works on the Sabbath shall be cut off from among his people
The person will be fined and forgiven
The person will be given extra work the next day
The person will be excluded from the tabernacle services temporarily
questions.correctAnswer: The soul that works on the Sabbath shall be cut off from among his people
questions.explanation: Verses 14-15 warn that working on the Sabbath causes the soul to be cut off from the community, showing the importance of holiness and purity in the covenant people’s life.

hard.title: Exodus Chapter 31 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Exodus Chapter 31.

questions.question: Who was specifically called by name by the LORD to be filled with the spirit of God for craftsmanship?
questions.correctAnswer: Bezalel
questions.explanation: Exodus 31:2-3 states that the LORD called Bezaleel by name and filled him with the spirit of God in wisdom, understanding, knowledge, and workmanship.

questions.question: Which tribes did Bezalel and Aholiab come from respectively?
questions.correctAnswer: Judah and Dan
questions.explanation: Bezalel was from the tribe of Judah and Aholiab from the tribe of Dan, as noted in Exodus 31:2 and 31:6.

questions.question: What was the primary purpose of the wisdom given to Bezalel, Aholiab, and others?
options: To make the tabernacle and its furnishings
To lead the Israelites in battle
questions.correctAnswer: To make the tabernacle and its furnishings
questions.explanation: Exodus 31:6-11 explain that wisdom was given to them to make the tabernacle, ark, altar, holy garments, and other sacred items as commanded by God.

questions.question: What is the significance of the Sabbath according to Exodus 31:13?
options: It is a sign between God and Israel throughout generations
It is a day for personal rest only
It is a day to gather food
It is a day to build the tabernacle
questions.correctAnswer: It is a sign between God and Israel throughout generations
questions.explanation: Verse 13 states the Sabbath is a sign between the LORD and the children of Israel throughout their generations, showing God's sanctification of them.

questions.question: What is the penalty for defiling the Sabbath by doing work on it?
questions.correctAnswer: Death
questions.explanation: Exodus 31:14 and 31:15 clearly state that anyone who does work on the Sabbath shall be put to death or cut off from among the people.

questions.question: How long is work permitted during the week according to Exodus 31?
questions.correctAnswer: Six days
questions.explanation: Verse 15 specifies that six days may work be done, but the seventh day is a Sabbath of rest holy to the LORD.

questions.question: How does Exodus 31 describe the Sabbath covenant's duration?
questions.correctAnswer: Perpetual covenant throughout generations
questions.explanation: Verse 16 states the children of Israel shall keep the Sabbath throughout their generations for a perpetual covenant.

questions.question: What cosmic event does the Sabbath commemorate according to Exodus 31:17?
options: God creating heaven and earth in six days and resting on the seventh
The giving of the law on Mount Sinai
questions.correctAnswer: God creating heaven and earth in six days and resting on the seventh
questions.explanation: Verse 17 explains the Sabbath is a sign because in six days the LORD made heaven and earth and rested on the seventh day and was refreshed.

questions.question: What did God give Moses after communing with him on Mount Sinai as recorded in this chapter?
options: Two tables of testimony, tables of stone, written with the finger of God
The Ten Commandments written on parchment
questions.correctAnswer: Two tables of testimony, tables of stone, written with the finger of God
questions.explanation: Exodus 31:18 states that God gave Moses two stone tables of testimony written by the finger of God.

questions.question: Which Old Testament passage also emphasizes the Sabbath as a sign of sanctification and covenant, connecting with Exodus 31:13-17?
questions.correctAnswer: Ezekiel 20:12-20
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 20:12-20 also highlights the Sabbath as a sign between God and Israel, emphasizing sanctification and covenant, paralleling Exodus 31:13-17.

questions.question: Which New Testament passage recalls the Sabbath rest as a foreshadowing of spiritual rest, linked to the Sabbath teaching in Exodus 31?
questions.correctAnswer: Hebrews 4:1-11
questions.explanation: Hebrews 4:1-11 interprets the Sabbath rest as a spiritual rest for believers, echoing the Sabbath command and rest principle from Exodus 31.

questions.question: What does the Hebrew word for 'Sabbath' (שַׁבָּת, Shabbat) primarily mean as it relates to Exodus 31?
questions.correctAnswer: Rest or cessation
questions.explanation: The Hebrew root of 'Sabbath' (Shabbat) means 'to rest or cease,' which aligns with the command to cease work on the seventh day in Exodus 31:15.

questions.question: What literary device is evident in the structure of the Sabbath command in Exodus 31:13-17 emphasizing the covenant and rest?
options: Inclusio framing the Sabbath as a perpetual sign
questions.correctAnswer: Inclusio framing the Sabbath as a perpetual sign
questions.explanation: The passage uses inclusio by beginning and ending with the Sabbath as a sign of the covenant, framing the entire section as a sacred instruction (Exodus 31:13 and 31:17).

questions.question: True or False: According to Exodus 31:14, anyone who works on the Sabbath will be cut off from among his people.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Exodus 31:14 clearly states that anyone who does work on the Sabbath shall be cut off from among his people.

questions.question: True or False: Exodus 31:18 describes the tablets given to Moses as written by Moses himself.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Exodus 31:18 states the tablets were written with the finger of God, not by Moses himself.

theological.title: Exodus Chapter 31 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Exodus Chapter 31 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: According to Exodus 31:3, what qualities did God fill Bezaleel with to accomplish his work?
options: The spirit of God, wisdom, understanding, knowledge, and craftsmanship
questions.correctAnswer: The spirit of God, wisdom, understanding, knowledge, and craftsmanship
questions.explanation: Exodus 31:3 states that God filled Bezaleel with the spirit of God, wisdom, understanding, knowledge, and all manner of workmanship to carry out his tasks.

questions.question: What is the significance of the Sabbath as described in Exodus 31:13?
options: A sign between God and Israel to show that He sanctifies them
A day for sacrifices and offerings
A day to gather manna in the wilderness
A memorial of the exodus from Egypt
questions.correctAnswer: A sign between God and Israel to show that He sanctifies them
questions.explanation: Exodus 31:13 teaches that the Sabbath is a sign between God and the children of Israel throughout their generations, signifying that the LORD sanctifies them.

questions.question: Which of the following items was NOT explicitly mentioned in Exodus 31:7-9 as part of the tabernacle furnishings?
questions.correctAnswer: The golden calf
questions.explanation: Exodus 31:7-9 lists the tabernacle, ark of the testimony, mercy seat, table, candlestick, altar of incense, altar of burnt offering, and laver with its base, but the golden calf is not mentioned here.

questions.question: What divine attribute is revealed by God's provision of wisdom to both Bezaleel and Aholiab for craftsmanship, according to Exodus 31:6?
questions.correctAnswer: Omniscience in equipping His servants
questions.explanation: Exodus 31:6 shows God's omniscience as He imparts wisdom to gifted individuals to fulfill His commands perfectly in constructing the tabernacle.

questions.question: How does Exodus 31:18 demonstrate God's attribute of holiness?
options: God personally inscribed the tablets with His finger, showing His pure and holy nature
God rested on the seventh day
questions.correctAnswer: God personally inscribed the tablets with His finger, showing His pure and holy nature
questions.explanation: Exodus 31:18 reveals God's holiness by showing that He Himself wrote the law on tablets with His finger, emphasizing the divine origin and sanctity of the covenant.

questions.question: What theological doctrine is underscored by the instruction in Exodus 31:14-15 about working on the Sabbath?
options: The sanctity of the Sabbath as a divine command with covenantal consequences
The universal priesthood of all believers
questions.correctAnswer: The sanctity of the Sabbath as a divine command with covenantal consequences
questions.explanation: Exodus 31:14-15 teaches that working on the Sabbath is forbidden under penalty of death, highlighting the Sabbath's holiness and covenantal significance.

questions.question: How does the combination of Exodus 31:2-5 and Exodus 31:6 enhance our understanding of God's providence in craftsmanship?
options: God providentially equips chosen individuals with wisdom and skill to fulfill His commands
God requires human effort without divine aid
God delegates work to angels only
questions.correctAnswer: God providentially equips chosen individuals with wisdom and skill to fulfill His commands
questions.explanation: Exodus 31:2-5 and 31:6 together show that God chose Bezaleel and Aholiab and filled them with wisdom and skill, demonstrating divine providence in equipping humans for sacred service.

questions.question: What is the relationship between the Sabbath command in Exodus 31:16-17 and the creation narrative?
options: The Sabbath commemorates God's rest after creating heaven and earth in six days
The Sabbath is unrelated to creation
The Sabbath was instituted during the exodus only
The Sabbath replaces the Passover festival
questions.correctAnswer: The Sabbath commemorates God's rest after creating heaven and earth in six days
questions.explanation: Exodus 31:16-17 explicitly connects the Sabbath observance with God's rest on the seventh day after creation, establishing it as a perpetual covenant sign.

questions.question: Sceptics claim that the Sabbath law is an outdated ritual with no relevance today. What does Exodus 31:13-17 actually teach about the Sabbath?
options: The Sabbath is a perpetual covenant and a sign of sanctification between God and His people
The Sabbath was only for priests and Levites
The Sabbath is a minor law with no covenant significance
The Sabbath was abolished after the temple was built
questions.correctAnswer: The Sabbath is a perpetual covenant and a sign of sanctification between God and His people
questions.explanation: Exodus 31:13-17 teaches that the Sabbath is a perpetual covenant and a sign that God sanctifies His people, affirming its ongoing theological significance.

questions.question: What doctrinal truth is emphasized by the command in Exodus 31:11 regarding obedience to all that God commanded Moses?
options: The necessity of faithful obedience in worship and covenant life
The optional nature of ceremonial laws
The primacy of moral laws only
questions.correctAnswer: The necessity of faithful obedience in worship and covenant life
questions.explanation: Exodus 31:11 underscores that the Israelites must carry out all God commanded Moses, emphasizing the doctrine of covenant faithfulness and obedience.

questions.question: Which theological insight can be drawn by combining Exodus 31:1 and Exodus 31:18 regarding divine revelation and human mediation?
options: God reveals His will directly to humans but also appoints mediators like Moses and skilled artisans to implement it
God reveals His law only through dreams
Humans create God's law by consensus
Divine revelation is unnecessary for worship
questions.correctAnswer: God reveals His will directly to humans but also appoints mediators like Moses and skilled artisans to implement it
questions.explanation: Exodus 31:1 shows God speaking to Moses, while 31:18 reveals God inscribing the law; this shows direct divine revelation combined with human mediation and craftsmanship in worship.

questions.question: What does Exodus 31:10 teach about the role of priestly garments in Israel's worship system?
options: Priestly garments are holy and designed for ministering in the priest's office
Priestly garments are for common use
Priestly garments symbolize wealth and status
questions.correctAnswer: Priestly garments are holy and designed for ministering in the priest's office
questions.explanation: Exodus 31:10 states that holy garments were made for Aaron and his sons to minister in the priest's office, emphasizing the sanctity and function of these vestments.

questions.question: How does Exodus 31:17 contribute to the biblical theology of God's rest and refreshment?
options: God rested and was refreshed on the seventh day, establishing a divine example for humanity
God never rests and is always active
God rested because He was tired
God rested only after creation was completed
questions.correctAnswer: God rested and was refreshed on the seventh day, establishing a divine example for humanity
questions.explanation: Exodus 31:17 indicates that God rested and was refreshed on the seventh day, providing a theological foundation for Sabbath rest as a divine pattern for humans.

questions.question: What does the combined teaching of Exodus 31:4-5 and 31:9 reveal about the nature of sacred objects and worship?
options: Sacred objects require skilled craftsmanship and are integral to worship
Sacred objects are unimportant and can be rough
Worship is entirely spiritual and needs no physical elements
Only gold and silver are acceptable materials
questions.correctAnswer: Sacred objects require skilled craftsmanship and are integral to worship
questions.explanation: Exodus 31:4-5 describes craftsmanship in gold, silver, brass, stones, and timber, while 31:9 includes altars and laver, showing that sacred objects are carefully made and essential for worship.

questions.question: What does Exodus 31:12-13 reveal about the covenantal relationship between God and Israel through the Sabbath?
options: The Sabbath is a perpetual sign of God's sanctifying presence among His people
The Sabbath is a temporary ordinance for the wilderness
The Sabbath is a sign of Israel's political independence
The Sabbath is a day for commercial trade
questions.correctAnswer: The Sabbath is a perpetual sign of God's sanctifying presence among His people
questions.explanation: Exodus 31:12-13 presents the Sabbath as a sign between God and Israel, symbolizing God's sanctification of His people throughout generations.
